# Gordon Greco LLC

> Global Tax and Wealth Advisors — fee-only fiduciary investment management specializing in tax-alpha generation.

Gordon Greco LLC is a registered investment advisory firm that provides tax-optimized wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and families. The firm is led by Markos Terzidis.

## Services

- Tax-Loss Harvesting: Systematic harvesting of portfolio losses to offset gains, reducing annual tax liability while maintaining market exposure.
- Asset Location: Placing tax-inefficient assets (bonds, REITs) in tax-deferred accounts and tax-efficient assets (index funds) in taxable accounts, saving 15-25 basis points annually.
- Roth Conversion: Strategic bracket-filling conversions from Traditional IRA to Roth IRA, locking in current tax rates against future increases.
- Qualified Dividend Income (QDI) Optimization: Maximizing qualified dividend income to benefit from the lower long-term capital gains rate.
- Estate & Trust Planning: Trust structure optimization, accumulation vs. distribution analysis, and multi-generational tax planning.
- Portfolio Construction: Evidence-based allocation using low-cost index funds, factor tilts, and Section 1256 contracts.

## Key Facts

- Fee structure: 1% of AUM annually (0.25% billed quarterly)
- Fiduciary: Yes — legally obligated to act in clients' best interest
- Fee-only: No commissions, no product sales
- Custodian: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) — one of the world's largest electronic brokerages
- Approach: Quantitative, data-driven, tax-focused
- Contact: markos@gordongreco.com

## How It Works

1. Schedule a free 30-minute consultation call
2. The firm analyzes your portfolio for tax-alpha opportunities
3. You receive an account application directly from Interactive Brokers (takes ~10 minutes)
4. Gordon Greco sets up and manages your portfolio with ongoing tax-aware optimization

## Tax Alpha Calculator

The website includes an interactive calculator that estimates annual tax savings based on portfolio size, account types (Taxable, IRA, Roth), and marginal tax rate. Strategies modeled:
- TLH: AUM x 2% harvestable losses x marginal rate
- Asset Location: AUM x 20 basis points (requires taxable + tax-deferred)
- QDI: AUM x 2% yield x 60% qualified x (marginal rate - 15% LTCG rate)
- Roth Conversion: $20K bracket room x (future rate - current rate)
